text:
maria: heads up — small but nasty regression after I tweaked the package `exports` in the JS SDK. added conditional browser/node fields and it broke imports on edge runtimes and TS inference in our quickstart sample. failing during edge build with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. :facepalm:

aj: thanks for flagging. which package exactly and which sample app? can you paste the failing error and the `exports` block?

maria: it's `@redwood/inference-js` (new name, previously `redwood-inference-js`). repro in `examples/quickstart-next` on latest main. build error:
```
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'redwood-inference-js' imported from /vercel/path/to/examples/quickstart-next/.vercel/output/functions/edge/handler/index.mjs
    at new NodeError (node:internal/errors:371:5)
    at Loader.resolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:1030:15)
    at Loader.getModuleJob (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:261:40)
    at async defaultGetModuleJob (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:596:20)
```
My `package.json` `exports` block now looks like:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "browser": "./dist/esm/browser.mjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

sam: hunch — edge runtimes (Vercel edge, Cloudflare) use an exporter resolution that sometimes expects a `default` or a fallback path for unknown conditions. they also prefer types to be present in the root entry for TS consumer inference. two quick things to try:
- add a generic fallback "\." : "./dist/esm/index.mjs" (or `./dist/index.mjs`) as a string fallback in `exports` so older resolvers pick it up
- add a top-level `types` field in package.json pointing to `./dist/index.d.ts`

aj: can you try adding a `node` conditional and a fallback? example:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "browser": "./dist/esm/browser.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
  }
}
```
That `default` key is informal but some bundlers read it. better is to add the string fallback variant: "\." : "./dist/esm/index.mjs" at same level.

devrel: we hit this in the onboarding matrix — customers using Next.js edge middleware or Vercel Edge Functions will fail silently and think SDK is incompatible. we should patch the quickstart samples and add a migration note in the changelog. also add a short troubleshooting snippet in docs.

maria: I added a failing CI step for `examples/quickstart-next` that runs a minimal vercel-build in CI (lightweight). build-bot just failed that check: see log excerpt.
build-bot: CI job `examples/quickstart-next / vercel-edge-build` failed — exit 1 — logs: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'redwood-inference-js'` (see above).

sam: long term solution: add a small postbuild script that writes `exports` with both conditional and fallback entries based on targets we want to support. also ensure `types` field added and `typesVersions` if we support older TS. and add a tiny edge-integration test that runs `node --experimental-loader`? or better: run `esbuild` resolution check in CI that validates import graph.

aj: I can draft a PR to:
- add `"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"` to package.json
- add top-level fallback string "\." : "./dist/esm/index.mjs" in exports alongside the conditional map
- add a short test `scripts/check-exports.js` that verifies the package can be resolved from a minimal edge-like ESM environment (using `es-module-lexer` + node resolve)

maria: that sounds great. for the immediate customer-facing fix i'm going to revert the recent exports-only change and publish a patch release with the fallback & types included. then we'll follow up with the stricter CI checks and docs updates.

devrel: please add a small note in `docs/onboarding.md` about Edge caveat + quick fix (one-liner to pin to patch or to use explicit import path).

sam: also add a tiny line in the SDK README with this snippet:
```
// if you hit ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on edge: temporary workaround
import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-js/dist/esm/index.mjs'
```

maria: filing the release PR now. thanks y'all. I'll link the PR and the patch release here when done. :thumbsup:

aj: volunteer to own the CI test after the patch lands.

maria: awesome — I'll post PR link in this thread once published.

build-bot: Release PR #1234 opened by maria -> `fix(exports): add fallback & types`

maria: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1234 — contains the minimal fallback, `types`, and a unit test for exports. planning to ship patch in next hour.

aj: thanks, will add CI test in follow-up.

sam: nice catch — this was subtle. worth a short postmortem in eng docs so we don't re-land an exports-only change without the compatibility matrix.

maria: agreed. closing loop after release.
